idleRecipe: async page => { const intervals=await page.evaluate(()=>new Promise(resolve=>{const intervals=[]; let previous; const start=performance.now(); function sample(now){if(previous!==undefined) intervals.push(now-previous); previous=now; if(now-start>=30000) resolve(intervals);else requestAnimationFrame(sample);}requestAnimationFrame(sample);})); const sorted=[...intervals].sort((a,b)=>a-b); return {intervals,count:intervals.length,p95:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.95)-1],p99:sorted[Math.ceil(sorted.length*.99)-1],max:sorted.at(-1)}; }
